'''Big Bunji''' was a small-time [[Zambarti]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and former associate of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from his days in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. He was described as a large, lavender-hued humanoid with an enormous head and saucepan eyes.

==Biography==
Big Bunji was a [[Zambarti]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]].<ref name="Viva Space Vegas!" /> When he failed to repay a debt, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] strafed his [[Habitation dome|pressure dome]], nearly killing him. Bunji met back up with Solo years later on the [[Jubilee Wheel (space station)|''Jubilee Wheel'']] in orbit around [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] under the alias of "Boss B". He was to give information on one of Solo's former associates, [[Reck Desh]], but their meeting was short-lived; the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attacked and Bunji retreated into a type of stronghold deeper into the ''Wheel''. He was last seen blasting out of the ''Jubilee Wheel''{{'s}} docking bay during the attack by Solo and his [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] co-pilot, [[Droma]]. Bunji was later noted for giving Solo information on Reck's whereabouts and next [[Peace Brigade]] operation. Bunji was also responsible for overseeing the shipment of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[West End Games]] [[roleplaying game]] adventure "[[There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip]]," the spelling of Big Bunji's name alternates with "Big Bungi."<ref name="There's Many a Slip Betwixt Cup and Lip" />
